name: Mexican Caribbean starter content pack
description: Curated recreational-diving starter content for Cozumel, Playa del Carmen and the wider Mexican Caribbean. It is intentionally not a complete biological catalogue.

sources.title: Parque Nacional Arrecifes de Cozumel
sources.publisher: Comisión Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas (CONANP)
sources.note: Official protected-area overview used for Cozumel marine-life plausibility and representative species. It is not used to infer encounter rarity.

sources.title: Estrategia de conservación para arrecifes saludables de Cozumel
sources.publisher: Comisión Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas (CONANP)
sources.note: Used for recreational dive-site names and dive/snorkel classification. The 2019 article's temporary access restrictions are historical and are not represented as current operating status.

sources.title: REEF Geographic Zone Report — Isla Cozumel (zone 5402)
sources.note: Current regional survey report used for observed marine-life presence and recreational site naming. REEF sighting-frequency/density fields are deliberately not stored or translated into rarity.

sources.title: REEF Geographic Zone Report — Puerto Morelos south including Playa del Carmen (zone 5403)
sources.note: Current Riviera Maya/Playa regional survey report used for observed marine-life presence and recreational site naming. REEF sighting-frequency/density fields are deliberately not stored or translated into rarity.

sources.title: Sepioteuthis sepioidea — Caribbean Reef Squid
sources.note: Used for Caribbean reef squid canonicalization and Caribbean range, including Cozumel.

sources.title: Panulirus argus — Caribbean spiny lobster
sources.publisher: Animal Diversity Web, University of Michigan Museum of Zoology
sources.note: Used for canonicalization and broad Caribbean habitat/range plausibility.

sources.title: Octopus briareus — Caribbean reef octopus
sources.publisher: Animal Diversity Web, University of Michigan Museum of Zoology
sources.note: Used for canonicalization and broad Caribbean reef habitat/range plausibility.

sources.title: Hippocampus reidi — Longsnout seahorse
sources.publisher: Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute — Shorefishes of the Greater Caribbean
sources.note: Used for canonicalization and Greater Caribbean range/habitat plausibility.

sources.title: Programa de Manejo Parque Marino Nacional Arrecifes de Cozumel, Quintana Roo
sources.publisher: Comisión Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas (CONANP)
sources.note: Official Cozumel management material used to confirm local occurrence of Stenopus hispidus, Diadema antillarum and queen conch under the historical name Strombus gigas. It is not used to infer encounter frequency.

sources.title: Queen Conch — Aliger gigas
sources.note: Used for current queen-conch taxonomy, accepted scientific name Aliger gigas, historical scientific synonyms, visible anatomy and Caribbean range.

sources.title: Balistes vetula — Queen Triggerfish
sources.publisher: Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute — Shorefishes of the Greater Caribbean
sources.note: Used for queen triggerfish canonicalization and diagnostic morphology; Cozumel occurrence is independently represented by the REEF Cozumel source.

sources.title: Eques punctatus — Spotted Drum
sources.publisher: Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute — Shorefishes of the Greater Caribbean
sources.note: Used for spotted-drum canonicalization and juvenile diagnostic morphology; Cozumel occurrence is independently represented by the REEF Cozumel source.

sources.title: Biodiversidad de equinodermos (Echinodermata) en México
sources.publisher: Revista Mexicana de Biodiversidad / Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México
sources.note: Used to confirm Oreaster reticulatus in the Mexican Caribbean; no abundance or encounter-rate inference is retained.

sources.title: C-53 Wreck Felipe Xicotencatl dive site
sources.note: Publishes a member-contributed location pin for the fixed wreck. Used only as one input to an approximate site position.

sources.title: C-53 Felipe Xicoténcatl Wreck, Cozumel
sources.note: Explicitly labels its C-53 coordinate approximate; used to corroborate the PADI wreck position without claiming survey precision.

sources.title: Palancar Gardens dive site
sources.note: Publishes a member-contributed Palancar Gardens location pin. Used as a representative reef-area anchor, not a fixed dive point.

sources.title: Palancar Gardens Dive Site, Cozumel
sources.note: Explicitly describes Palancar Gardens as a reef section and its map position as approximate; used to constrain precision semantics.

sources.title: Santa Rosa Wall dive site
sources.note: Publishes a member-contributed Santa Rosa Wall location pin. Used as an approximate site anchor.

sources.title: Santa Rosa Wall Dive Site, Cozumel
sources.note: Publishes an independently sourced Santa Rosa Wall position close to the PADI pin; used as corroboration, not as a drop-point claim.

sources.title: Mama Viña Wreck, Playa del Carmen
sources.note: Explicitly labels the published wreck position approximate and says the operator briefing supplies the mooring.

sources.title: Mama Viña Dive Site Guide
sources.note: Publishes a second Mama Viña coordinate near the Reefwander point; used only to corroborate the approximate wreck area.

sources.title: Moc-Che dive site
sources.note: Publishes a generic Moc-Che member-contributed location pin. Used only to bound the deep reef position.

sources.title: Moc Che Deep Dive Site, Playa del Carmen
sources.note: Publishes a position specifically for Moc-Che Deep. The drift reef is treated as an approximate site, not a fixed entry point.

sources.title: Pared Verde dive site
sources.note: Publishes a Pared Verde member-contributed map pin. Because other published points differ materially, it is used only as a broad reef-area anchor.

sources.title: Pared Verde
sources.note: Publishes a community GPS point for Pared Verde roughly 2 km from the PADI point; the disagreement is preserved in the site's reef-area precision classification.

sources.title: Dive Site Talk: Tortugas in Playa del Carmen
sources.note: Local operator description says Tortugas covers roughly one square kilometre; used to prevent a published point from being misrepresented as exact.

sources.title: Tortugas
sources.note: Publishes a community GPS point for Tortugas. Used as a representative reef-area anchor only.
